title: REVISE: A Tool for Measuring and Mitigating Bias in Visual Datasets
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the ethical problem of bias and fairness in AI datasets. It introduces a tool specifically designed to measure and mitigate these ethical issues (e.g., gender, skin tone, geographic representation). The work is fundamentally about improving the ethics of data collection and model development, making it a core component of the research, not just a brief consideration.
